name: LocalTry
summary: CRM for service businesses and agencies that combines customers, jobs, scheduling, invoices, reviews and marketing with an AI assistant that can also be reached through MCP.
best_for: small service businesses and agencies that want customers, jobs, invoices, reviews and marketing in one CRM and would like to connect their own AI tool
skip_if: you want a trial without a card, you need a refund option, or you want to know the setup cost before you start
honest_knock: A card is needed even for the 3-day trial, and incurred charges are normally non-refundable. A $999 setup charge was only waived for a limited time, and the dedicated ChatGPT plugin is still listed as coming soon.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on localtry.com/pricing) LocalTry has three plans that all include the same 133 capabilities and differ by team size and workspace count: Core is $59 a month for 2 users and 1 workspace, Operator is $99 a month for 5 users and 15 workspaces, and Scale is $199 a month for 10 users and 50 workspaces. Each plan starts with a 3-day free trial, and the page says to add a card through Stripe and that your first charge comes after the trial unless you cancel. The page also shows a $999 setup, customization and data-transfer charge that was free for the next 7 days at the time we read it; that is a promotion and not part of the subscription price, so ask what it costs once the offer ends. The pricing page says there is no plan-based cap on AI actions, but provider usage limits apply. The terms say paid subscriptions renew for the selected period until cancelled and that incurred charges are normally non-refundable. Prices are in US dollars; we did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.
